# create_group()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.create_group`

## Signature

```python
async def create_group(title: str, users: Union[Union[int, str], List[Union[int, str]]]) -> 'types.Chat': ...
```

## Documentation

Create a new basic group.

> [!NOTE]
> If you want to create a new supergroup, use [`create_supergroup`](create_supergroup.md) instead.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`title`** (`str`)
  The group title.

- **`users`** (`int` | `str` | List of `int` or `str`)
  Users to create a chat with.
  You must pass at least one user using their IDs (int), usernames (str) or phone numbers (str).
  Multiple users can be invited by passing a list of IDs, usernames or phone numbers.

### Returns

[`Chat`](../../types/user_and_chats/Chat.md): On success, a chat object is returned.

### Example

```python
await app.create_group("Group Title", user_id)
```
